Bridge-panel model retains six lower joints, five upper joints, five bottom members, four top members, ten diagonals and two abutments. Triangular geometry is re-created at 28 mm bay spacing, with original 4 mm bottom-member and 2 mm remaining strokes retained. Abutment top boundaries sit 2 mm below bottom-member centrelines, preserving the source painted contact rather than treating that overlap as an unrelated gap. This is a structural topology model, not a load-rating calculation.", "canvas_mm": [168, 85]}, "teaching": "Bridge-panel model retains six lower joints, five upper joints, five bottom members, four top members, ten diagonals and two abutments. Abutment top boundaries sit 2 mm below bottom-member centrelines, preserving the source painted contact rather than treating that overlap as an unrelated gap. This is a structural topology model, not a load-rating calculation. External object-name and viewpoint key required; physical tactile and learner evaluation remain pending.
